_about: Findings of dev/check_pages.py that are known, handed to the chat that owns the page, and listed in docs/ROADMAP.md. The page check still prints them (marked 'known') but does not fail on them. Each entry: page (as the page check names it), the check, the owning chat, the date and why it waits. Remove an entry in the same change that fixes it; an entry older than 14 days is reported as overdue.

issues.why: the tag links under the title (a.tag.link) and the section-head links (a.aside) are 22 to 24 px tall on phones; shared components, fixed in shared/theme.css (handoff of Nov 19, 2026)
the asteroid's facts and orbit are drawn after the data arrives; placeholders of their size are needed in the page
the search view is drawn by script after the page opens; its box and first lines need placeholders in the page

picture() in app.js waits 20 seconds before its second try and leaves the failed picture on show meanwhile; hide it (data-failed, or a 'retrying' state) from the first failure, and show it again when the second try loads
